description: A Node.js script for safely cleaning specific Next.js cache directories, including '.next' and 'node_modules/.cache'. It avoids shell commands for environments that disallow destructive commands, performing internal file system operations to delete cache directories.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to stdout with a newline.

methods.name: rmDirIfExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and removes it recursively; logs accordingly.
